questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-98
questions.question: A driver may park in a space reserved for people with disabilities if the vehicle displays license plates for the disabled:

options.text: Regardless of who is in the vehicle
Only if the driver is disabled
And is carrying a disabled person named on the registration
If someone in the driver's immediate family is disabled

questions.answer_text: And is carrying a disabled person named on the registration

questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-99
questions.question: Before you leave a parking space which is parallel to the curb, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn
Turn on your four-way flasher
Look for traffic by turning your head
Look for traffic by using your inside rear-view mirror

questions.answer_text: Look for traffic by turning your head

questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-104
questions.question: A "no parking" sign at a certain location means:

options.text: You may never stop your vehicle there
You may stop temporarily to load or unload passengers
You may park there if the driver remains in the vehicle
You may leave your vehicle unattended for less than 5 minutes

questions.answer_text: You may stop temporarily to load or unload passengers

questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-100
questions.question: If you are parked parallel to the curb, you may get out of the car on the traffic side:

options.text: During the daytime when other drivers can see you
When the traffic light at the closest intersection turns red
When you won't interfere with oncoming vehicles
If you use your four-way flasher first

questions.answer_text: When you won't interfere with oncoming vehicles

questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-101
questions.question: Assuming that the street is level, what should you do after you have finished parallel parking in a space between two other cars?

options.text: Leave your front wheels turned toward the curb
Make sure your car almost touches the car behind you
Move as far forward in the space as possible
Straighten your front wheels and leave room between cars

questions.answer_text: Straighten your front wheels and leave room between cars

questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-97
questions.question: In a parking space reserved for people with disabilities, a non-disabled driver:

options.text: May park in an emergency
May not park, but stop in an emergency
May not park or stop, but may stand in an emergency
May neither park, stop, nor stand

questions.answer_text: May neither park, stop, nor stand

options.text: On a one-way street
At the entrance of a building
In a crosswalk
Within 50 feet of a fire hydrant

questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-105
questions.question: A "no standing" sign at a certain location means:

options.text: You may never stop your vehicle there
You may park there if the driver remains in the vehicle
You may stop temporarily to pick up or discharge passengers
You may stop to load or unload merchandise

questions.answer_text: You may stop temporarily to pick up or discharge passengers

questions.name: sgE-7355139-1-103
questions.question: A "no stopping" sign means that, unless directed to do so by a policeman, you may stop only:

options.text: Long enough to unload packages
To avoid conflict with other traffic
To discharge passengers
For less than 5 minutes

questions.answer_text: To avoid conflict with other traffic
